column8: Named bundle of options (see --list-presets): applied above the saved config file and below environment and command line. Empty = none.

Color model. stylized: original art-directed palette. kipthorne: symmetric amber blackbody (Interstellar). faithful: Doppler and redshift shifted blackbody. singularity: strict monochrome white on black (Singularity desktop). slingshot: rust disk with a gold-white beamed arc. whitehole: icy teal and steel blue. eht: Event Horizon Telescope false color (orange crescent).
Seconds to cross-fade when the palette changes (palette cycling). 0 switches instantly.
Comma separated palettes to cycle through after the first one. Empty disables cycling.
Seconds each palette stays before cross-fading to the next one in the cycle list.
Overall brightness multiplier applied before tone mapping.
Surface brightness of the accretion disk relative to the per-launch value.
Strength of the halo around the shadow, as a multiple of the palette's own halo (stylized, kipthorne and faithful have none).
Cyan and magenta color fringing at the bright disk edges (whitehole palette).
Strength of Doppler shift and relativistic beaming: 0 removes the bright/dim asymmetry, 2 doubles it.
Multiplier on the number of background stars.
Multiplier on the background nebula clouds.
Multiplier on the polar jets. 0 turns them off.
Amplitude of the rotating bright sector in the stylized palette.

auto: per-launch random path (previous behavior). orbit and slow-orbit: circular. equatorial: fly past along the disk plane. polar: over the poles. plunge: dive toward the horizon and out. slingshot: swoop in close on a hyperbolic arc and leave. drift: very slow wandering. random: pick one per cycle.
Time scale of the whole animation (camera, disk rotation, palette drift).
Closest camera distance in units of the Schwarzschild radius; 0 = per-path default. Values below 3.2 are raised to 3.2 so the camera never crosses the horizon.
Farthest camera distance; 0 = per-path default.
Elevation of the view above the disk plane in degrees; -1 = automatic.
Seconds per flyby before it restarts with a new variation (with a short fade); 0 = the path's natural length.
Dimensionless spin a/M. Approximation: moves the inner disk edge inward and speeds up the disk (not full Kerr geodesics).
Multiplier on the disk rotation rate.
Multiplier on the disk's slow precession (auto camera path only).
Multiplier on the disk heat, which shifts colors toward the hot end.
Outer radius of the accretion disk in Schwarzschild radii. Presets use large values for quasars.
Length scale of the polar jets in Schwarzschild radii (brightness falls off exponentially).
Opacity of a dusty torus ring around the disk (quasar look). Artistic straight-ray approximation.
Show a blue companion star and the gas stream it feeds the disk with (microquasar look). Artistic.
Turn off to draw straight rays (debugging).
Measure frame times and lower the ray-step budget when frames miss the display refresh, with hysteresis (only when quality is auto). Resolution is controlled by the shared render-scale options.
Ray-march step budget tier. auto picks by GPU and adapts to frame time.
Fixes the per-launch randomness so a run can be reproduced; 0 = random.
